text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall despite some declines, but that does not mean future returns are assured; I should stay focused on preserving retirement savings.","Selling part of Stocks C and D at a gain reduced those positions and realized profits, but I should not assume past gains predict what they will do next.","I should keep trades measured and consider my overall holdings and cash needs, rather than reacting to a single month’s account change."]}
